children: Brent rose toward $108 a barrel, a 4-month high, after rallying almost 9% last week, after Saudi Arabia shut a major crude pipeline following drone attacks, disrupting a key route used to bypass the Strait of Hormuz.
Saudi Arabia halted the East-West pipeline as a precaution after Thursday’s attacks, with no indication yet of when operations will resume.
Meanwhile, talks between Iran and several Gulf nations on establishing a temporary shipping lane through Hormuz were postponed, Oman’s Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi said.

title: Oil Prices Jump
